tools.name: verify_domain
tools.description: Validates domain registration status and DNS presence for any domain name.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain name to verify, e.g. stripe.com

tools.name: resolve_domain_dns
tools.description: Resolves full DNS record set for any domain including A, AAAA, MX, TXT and NS records.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain name to resolve, e.g. stripe.com

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register a new agent in the Revnuvo verification system. Returns an agent_id used for all subsequent calls.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a verification task assigned to an agent, with optional constraints the result must satisfy.

params.name: agent_id
params.description: The agent_id to assign this task to

tools.name: submit_result
tools.description: Submit a result for a task. Must be called before verify_task.

params.name: task_id
params.description: The task_id to submit a result for

params.name: result_data
params.description: The result payload as a JSON object

tools.name: verify_task
tools.description: Run verification checks on a submitted task result. Returns verdict (PASS, FAIL, PARTIAL), score, and per-check details. Also updates agent reputation.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get an agent's profile including reputation score, task stats, and recent verification history.

tools.name: assess_domain
tools.description: Assess the trust and risk score of any domain. Returns trust_score, risk_score, grade (A-F), recommendation (TRUSTED/REVIEW/RISKY), and risk flags like NO_DMARC, NO_SPF, NO_DNSSEC.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain to assess, e.g. stripe.com

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Get agents ranked by reputation score. Optionally filter by minimum task count.

params.name: min_tasks
params.description: Only include agents with at least this many tasks
